name: Lost Island 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Lost Land 2 is a bubble shooter game that has several levels for you to play! Explore through these mysterious islands full of unknown creatures and eerie forest. Through the fog, you will find a bubble shooter game with multiple levels. Aim and shoot the cannon at the wandering snake as you stop it before it reaches the end. Aim bubbles of the color to create a 3 matching set which will cause the bubbles to disappear and shorten the devious snake. Be careful of obstacles in your way that will cause bubbles to bounce off and attach to the wrong part of the snake. If you need a different colored bubble, click on the cannon to see your options. Don’t take too long because the snake will continue to move along the path to try to defeat you in this online game. Finish all 20 levels in this fun bubble shooter game!
